text: Anndee ko Allah Harmini e mo'on immorde e ñaametee, ko ko maayiri nii, e ƴiiƴam rufaaɗam iloojam, e teewu kose, e kon ko innde goo jaŋtaade e mu'un ka hirsugol ka wanaa innde Allah.Si neɗɗo o duñaama e ñaamugol huunde tuma o saɗtiraa, hara wanaa feƴƴintingol ko haani kon; haray bakkatu e lepte fawaaki mo.Pellet Allah Ya'fotooɗo kala tuuɓuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen,Yurmeteeɗo ɓe.Hino jeyaa e Yurmeende Makko nden, tawde o yawtanii ya'fike kala on ñaamirɗo ko harmi fewndo duñiraa.
